name: Docling
tagline: Open-source document parsing toolkit that converts PDFs, DOCX, and PPTX into structured Markdown and JSON for local RAG.
real_test_summary: Tested parsing multi-column technical PDFs and tables locally into clean Markdown chunks without cloud uploads. Preserves headings and table rows reliably for downstream RAG indexing.
pros: Clean Markdown and structured JSON output tailored for local RAG pipelines
Handles complex tables, formulas, and multi-page layouts offline
Permissive MIT license with active Python CLI and library support
cons: First run downloads layout and table models locally
Scanned image-heavy PDFs take longer on CPU-only hardware
